text:
Marta: Morning! Quick heads-up — we have a conference group dropping off materials today at 11:30. If you're expecting them, please note front desk needs a host name for visitor badging. Drop host name in thread. :wave:
frontdesk-bot: Package arrival scheduled: 11:25 AM — 3 items from 'PaperCo'. Will hold at front desk. Check-in policy: host must meet visitors upstairs.
Emily: Thanks — that's mine. I'll be there at 11:20 to sign them in.
Jordan: FYI: my teammate needs an accessible seat near the back table. Can we reserve a hotdesk?
Marta: @Jordan noted — reserving Hotdesk B (by the big window). Add name: 'Samir Patel'.
Cameron: Also, quick PSA: if teams want to drop off promo swag, use locker 4. Code is `2431-OD`. Front desk will give temporary badge 'VIS' to drop-offs only.
Ryan: small correction — locker code changed to `2431` (no suffix). Front desk updated signage.
Leila: Is there a place to leave personal packages that aren't for distribution? I have a personal amazon box arriving.
frontdesk-bot: Personal packages are logged and held for 7 days. Please add "Personal: YourName" on the shipping label. Packages left longer will be sent to Lost & Found.
Emily: quick question — can a non-employee pick up a package? (ex: my partner)
Marta: Yes, with ID and matching name on the label. If you're worried, leave a note for front desk and CC them here.
Jordan: Also, reminders for spare badges: engineering cupboard (4th shelf, labeled 'SPARE BADGES') has 5 temporarys. Please return after use.
Cameron: tiny ask — if you borrow a spare, DM me so I can update the inventory. :memo:
Emily: will do. thanks!
Marta: Thanks all — I'll post a one-line sign for the lobby: "Conference drop-off 11:30 — host: Emily. Use Locker 4 for swag. Temporary badges at front desk." Anyone want to proof?
Leila: looks good. maybe add 'accessible seating reserved'?
Marta: good call — adding it.
Emily: perfect, see you at 11:20 :thumbsup:
frontdesk-bot: Logged: host=Emily, visitors=3, materials=3 items, locker=4, badge_type=VIS.
Cameron: thanks team. If anyone runs into package congestion today ping me and I'll reroute to overflow shelf A.
Ryan: noted. I can grab overflow shelf A key if needed.
Marta: Great — closing thread. Ping if anything changes.
